stem: Approximately what proportion of children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis have systemic-onset disease?
explanation: Systemic-onset juvenile idiopathic arthritis accounts for about 10 percent of juvenile idiopathic arthritis, with oligoarticular disease being more common overall.
